question: What is the main focus of health maintenance compared to curative medicine?

options.B: Treating advanced stages of chronic diseases

explanation: Health maintenance aims to keep people healthy and stop diseases before they start, rather than just treating sickness after it happens. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h1)

question: Why is health promotion an important duty for midwives in Nigerian communities?

options.A: It generates high financial revenue for the local government
options.B: It reduces the load on hospitals by empowering families to prevent sickness
options.C: It replaces the need for doctors in primary health clinics
options.D: It is required only during disease outbreaks in urban centers

explanation: When midwives teach families about nutrition, hygiene, and family planning, fewer people get seriously ill, which helps ease the pressure on big hospitals. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h1)

question: Which Nigerian agency is responsible for checking the safety of food and medicines?
explanation: NAFDAC was established specifically to control and regulate the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of food, drugs, and other regulated products in Nigeria. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h2)

question: Which of the following is NOT a direct duty of the National Primary Health Care Development Agency (NPHCDA)?
explanation: Tertiary teaching hospitals are overseen directly by the Federal Ministry of Health and hospital boards, whereas the NPHCDA focuses strictly on primary care and community-level services. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h2)

question: What is a major advantage of community-based groups in local healthcare delivery?

options.A: They have the legal power to enact national health laws
options.B: They operate exclusively as tertiary referral centers
options.C: They possess deep local trust and cultural understanding
options.D: They receive the largest share of the federal health budget

explanation: Local community groups are trusted by residents, making it easier to convince people to participate in health programs like immunizations. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h3)

question: A rural health clinic needs to distribute mosquito nets quickly to pregnant mothers in a riverine village. Which partner is best suited to help mobilize the local residents?

options.A: A tertiary teaching hospital board of directors
options.B: A local community-based organization with strong grassroots ties
options.C: An international trade export promotion council
options.D: The federal legislative committee on pharmaceutical oversight

explanation: Community organizations know the terrain and the people well, making them ideal for grassroots mobilization and distribution tasks. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h3)

question: Which international body focuses mainly on child health, nutrition, and vaccine supply worldwide?
explanation: UNICEF is the United Nations agency dedicated specifically to protecting children's rights, health, and nutritional needs globally. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h4)

question: How do international health bodies like the WHO mainly assist the Nigerian health sector?

options.A: By collecting taxes from local pharmaceutical manufacturing plants
options.B: By providing technical guidelines, funding, and support for disease control
options.C: By taking over the complete administration of all state hospitals
options.D: By passing binding legislative acts in the National Assembly

explanation: International agencies support national efforts by sharing expert advice, setting standards, and funding vital public health campaigns. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h4)

question: Why is teamwork between different health agencies important for midwives in clinical and community practice?

options.A: No single health agency has all the resources to solve every community health problem alone
options.B: It allows nurses to avoid clinical duties by passing patients to administrative staff
options.C: Government regulations mandate that every nurse must run an independent NGO
options.D: It eliminates the need for patient consent during health outreaches

explanation: Healthcare is complex, and sharing resources between government bodies, NGOs, and hospitals ensures patients get complete support. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h5)

question: A midwife in a health center notices a sudden rise in cholera cases in the local market. What immediate action should she take?

options.A: Report the outbreak to local public health authorities for prompt action
options.B: Refer all affected patients abroad for specialized treatment
options.C: Close the clinic permanently until the rainy season ends
options.D: Wait until the end of the year to include it in the routine budget

explanation: Timely disease reporting to public health agencies allows the government to send help quickly and prevent a wider outbreak. [learn more](BMP110_U1_T7#BMP110_U1_T7_h5)
